name: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On
description: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test — while shacking up with other potential matches — in a provocative reality series.

videos.title: The Split
videos.overview: Emotions are high--and sparks fly--as the couples part then embark on the ultimate love challenge. Can they pick a new partner, with real potential?

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Will attraction evolve into deeper connection? Selecting a live-in match makes for flirty fun--and hurt feelings. Time for a life-changing choice.

videos.title: New Bed, New Partner
videos.overview: One shock follows another as an honest, tearful outburst leaves everyone speechless. Later, the accelerated trial unions kick off with pillow talk.

videos.title: Girls & Guys Night Out
videos.overview: Love may be blossoming, but jealousy gets in the way. We're moving fast, so meet the racer dad. The truth stings as everyone trades notes over drinks.

videos.title: Pushing Boundaries
videos.overview: After an evening of strained cocktail hours, couples cuddle--and implode. A forbidden meeting ends with drama as short-term spouses push each other.

videos.title: The Changeover
videos.overview: Major feelings emerge at the changeover. Everyone's back with their original partners, but the transition might be bumpier than anyone ever imagined.

videos.title: Back to Reality
videos.overview: Tears tarnish a bachelorette bash. Longtime loves try to listen and hold on to hope. The couples board the party bus to bond, awkwardly, at a winery.

videos.title: Time to Answer the Ultimatum
videos.overview: An all-nighter deals a blow to a fragile relationship. Can bruised feelings be soothed by a temp partner? Family weigh in with love on the line.

videos.title: Ultimatum Day
videos.overview: Ultimatum Day arrives. Now the couples must decide whether they'll marry the love they know, reconnect with an attractive alternative — or walk away.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Where are they now? Catch up with the couples as they revisit the experience and talk about their lives since the series with Vanessa and Nick.

videos.title: The Split
videos.overview: The couples spend tense and tearful last nights together. Then, jealousy brews as they begin mingling amongst each other to make connections.

videos.title: Unexpected Revelations
videos.overview: For some, the sight of their ex dating others proves too much to bear. After a dramatic confrontation, everyone prepares to choose their live-in partner.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: A stunning revelation shifts the group dynamics. Following the choice ceremony, the new couples move in together — there's no going back now.

videos.title: Catching Feelings
videos.overview: From picnics and meeting parents to heart-to-heart conversations, the trial marriages continue. Which bonds will flourish, and which will fizzle?

videos.title: Are You The One?
videos.overview: Time to sip and tell: brutal honesty abounds over drinks at ladies and guys night, and as harsh opinions come to light, friction grows.

videos.title: The Changeover
videos.overview: The fallout from cocktail hour changes several couples' perspectives. Strong words and hard truths are shared during an intense changeover.

videos.title: Change of Heart
videos.overview: Finally reunited, the original couples start a new round of marriages with fresh eyes. But the transition is bumpy — and even bitter — for some.

videos.title: Time to Answer the Ultimatum
videos.overview: With only three days of the experiment left, the couples consult with friends and family. Can romantic gestures and deep talks ease lingering doubts?

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: After a historic finale, the group reunites with Nick and Vanessa for a heartfelt and heated sit-down about their experience and where they're at now.

videos.title: The Split
videos.overview: The couples spend one last night together before becoming exes. Everyone gets their flirt on at speed dating, but later, jealousy crashes the party.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Sparks fly as the singles mingle and explore new bonds, but emotions run high when the time comes to select their trial partners.

videos.title: Sealed With A Kiss
videos.overview: After selecting their live-in match, the six new couples begin their three-week journey together. But the first 24 hours stir up intense emotions.

videos.title: Ghosted
videos.overview: A shocking twist changes the group's dynamic, leaving some participants scrambling. Honesty plays a key role as the trial couples deepen their bonds.

videos.title: Just Here For A Hall Pass?
videos.overview: As "The Changeover" looms, the new pairs meet friends and family. Tensions flare when the men and women separate for a night of drinking and real talk.

videos.title: Fortune Favors the Bold
videos.overview: The final week of trial marriages wraps up with some feeling anxious about upcoming reunions. One participant ends up with a regrettable tattoo.

videos.title: The Changeover
videos.overview: The reunited original partners grapple with painful truths as they share insights from their three-week unions and embark on a new round of marriages.

videos.title: You're Playing with Fire
videos.overview: As decision day looms, the couples unpack their relationships — some with newfound appreciation. For others, it may be their last night together.

videos.title: Ultimatum Day
videos.overview: After several weeks of trial marriages, the moment of truth arrives. The couples must decide whether to stay together amid tears of joy — and heartbreak.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Accusations, raw feelings and revelations surface when the couples gather for an emotional reunion with surprise guests — and previously unaired footage.

videos.title: The Split
videos.overview: Six new couples arrive to test their relationships, but flirtations during speed dating and cocktail hour unleash jealousy on day one.

videos.title: Seven Days of Temptation
videos.overview: Money. Sex. Killer whales. No topic is off limits across a week of dates as the exes decide who they see a future with before making their choice.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Two participants send shockwaves through the choice ceremony. When the dust settles, the new couples move in together for three weeks of trial marriage.

videos.title: One Door Closes, Another Bedroom Opens
videos.overview: Two couples break the rules and clash face-to-face in a dramatic showdown as jealousy and betrayal dominate the start of their trial marriages.

videos.title: He Said, She Said
videos.overview: Drama runs amok when a contestant must answer for what they've said. Later, truths emerge at Guys Night, and the women take sides at Ladies Night.

videos.title: Masterminds of Manipulation
videos.overview: As the turbulent month wraps up with a volatile changeover ceremony, some couples are ready to return to normal while others aren't so sure.

videos.title: The Changeover
videos.overview: Building on the trial marriages, everyone brings new perspectives to their original partners. But clashing love languages threaten one couple's future.

videos.title: Question Everything
videos.overview: With only two weeks to go, the couples get a fresh look at their old relationships when they meet with their families in preparation for ultimatum day.
